sanskrit: sa rājā rājaśārdūla māndhātā parameṣṭhinaḥ jagrāha śirasā pādau yajñe viṣṇor mahātmanaḥ
english: That king, O tiger among kings, that Māndhātā, bowed his head and clasped the feet of the Supreme One, of the great-souled Viṣṇu, at the sacrifice.

sanskrit: darśayām āsa taṃ viṣṇū rūpam āsthāya vāsavam sa pārthivair vṛtaḥ sadbhir arcayām āsa taṃ prabhum
english: Viṣṇu revealed himself to him, assuming the form of Vāsava; and the king, surrounded by virtuous princes, worshipped that Lord.

sanskrit: tasya pārthivasaṃghasya tasya caiva mahātmanaḥ saṃvādo 'yaṃ mahān āsīd viṣṇuṃ prati mahādyute
english: Between that assembly of kings and that great-souled one there took place this great dialogue concerning Viṣṇu, O you of mighty splendour.

sanskrit: indra uvāca kim iṣyate dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha; yad draṣṭukāmo 'si tam aprameyam anantamāyāmitasattvavīryaṃ; nārāyaṇaṃ hy ādidevaṃ purāṇam
english: Indra said: What do you desire, O best of the upholders of dharma, that you wish to behold the immeasurable one — Nārāyaṇa, the primeval first god, of boundless illusion and unmeasured being and might?

sanskrit: nāsau devo viśvarūpo mayāpi; śakyo draṣṭuṃ brahmaṇā vāpi sākṣāt ye 'nye kāmās tava rājan hṛdisthā; dāsyāmi tāṃs tvaṃ hi martyeṣu rājā
english: That god of universal form cannot be seen face to face even by me, nor even by Brahmā. Whatever other desires lie within your heart, O king, those I shall grant — for you are a king among mortals.

sanskrit: satye sthito dharmaparo jitendriyaḥ; śūro dṛḍhaṃ prītirataḥ surāṇām buddhyā bhaktyā cottamaśraddhayā ca; tatas te 'haṃ dadmi varaṃ yatheṣṭam
english: Steadfast in truth, devoted to dharma, master of your senses, a hero firmly delighting in the gods — for your wisdom, your devotion, and your supreme faith, I therefore grant you a boon as you wish.

sanskrit: māndhātovāca asaṃśayaṃ bhagavann ādidevaṃ; drakṣyāmy ahaṃ śirasāhaṃ prasādya tyaktvā bhogān dharmakāmo hy araṇyam; icche gantuṃ satpathaṃ lokajuṣṭam
english: Māndhātā said: Without doubt, O Lord, I shall behold the primeval god, having won his favour with my head bowed. Renouncing pleasures, longing for dharma, I wish to go to the forest, to the righteous path that the worthy frequent.

sanskrit: kṣātrād dharmād vipulād aprameyāl; lokāḥ prāptāḥ sthāpitaṃ svaṃ yaśaś ca dharmo yo 'sāv ādidevāt pravṛtto; lokajyeṣṭhas taṃ na jānāmi kartum
english: By the kṣatriya dharma, vast and immeasurable, I have won the worlds and established my own fame. But that dharma which proceeded from the primeval god, the foremost in the world — that I do not know how to fulfil.

sanskrit: indra uvāca asainiko 'dharmaparaś carethāḥ; parāṃ gatiṃ lapsyase cāpramattaḥ kṣātro dharmo hy ādidevāt pravṛttaḥ; paścād anye śeṣabhūtāś ca dharmāḥ
english: Indra said: Should you walk without an army and turned away from dharma, you would still attain the highest goal only by remaining vigilant. For the kṣatriya dharma proceeded from the primeval god, and the other duties came afterward, as its remainders.

sanskrit: śeṣāḥ sṛṣṭā hy antavanto hy anantāḥ; suprasthānāḥ kṣatradharmāviśiṣṭāḥ asmin dharme sarvadharmāḥ praviṣṭās; tasmād dharmaṃ śreṣṭham imaṃ vadanti
english: Those remainders, though created with limits, become endless and lead well onward, being grounded in the kṣatriya dharma. Into this dharma all the other duties have entered; therefore men call this dharma the highest.

sanskrit: karmaṇā vai purā devā ṛṣayaś cāmitaujasaḥ trātāḥ sarve pramathyārīn kṣatradharmeṇa viṣṇunā
english: For in olden days the gods and the seers of measureless might were all delivered by deeds, when Viṣṇu, through the kṣatriya dharma, crushed their foes.

sanskrit: yadi hy asau bhagavān nāhaniṣyad; ripūn sarvān vasumān aprameyaḥ na brāhmaṇā na ca lokādikartā; na saddharmā nādidharmā bhaveyuḥ
english: For had that Lord, the wealth-bearing and immeasurable one, not slain all the enemies, there would be no brāhmaṇas, no maker of the worlds and the rest, no true dharma, and no primal dharma at all.

sanskrit: imām urvīṃ na jayed vikrameṇa; devaśreṣṭho 'sau purā ced ameyaḥ cāturvarṇyaṃ cāturāśramyadharmāḥ; sarve na syur brahmaṇo vai vināśāt
english: Had that immeasurable best of the gods not in olden times conquered this earth by his valour, the four varṇas and the duties of the four āśramas would all be no more, through the destruction of brahman itself.

sanskrit: dṛṣṭā dharmāḥ śatadhā śāśvatena; kṣātreṇa dharmeṇa punaḥ pravṛttāḥ yuge yuge hy ādidharmāḥ pravṛttā; lokajyeṣṭhaṃ kṣatradharmaṃ vadanti
english: The eternal duties, seen in their hundredfold forms, are set in motion again and again by the kṣatriya dharma; in age after age the primal duties are set forth. Therefore men call the kṣatriya dharma the foremost in the world.

sanskrit: ātmatyāgaḥ sarvabhūtānukampā; lokajñānaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pālanaṃ ca viṣaṇṇānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pīḍitānāṃ; kṣātre dharme vidyate pārthivānām
english: Self-sacrifice, compassion for all beings, knowledge of the world, the granting of release, protection, and the deliverance of the despairing and the afflicted — all these are found, for kings, in the kṣatriya dharma.

sanskrit: nirmaryādāḥ kāmamanyupravṛttā; bhītā rājño nādhigacchanti pāpam śiṣṭāś cānye sarvadharmopapannāḥ; sādhvācārāḥ sādhu dharmaṃ caranti
english: The lawless, driven by desire and wrath, do not fall into sin out of fear of the king; while the disciplined others, endowed with every virtue and of righteous conduct, righteously practise dharma.

sanskrit: putravat paripālyāni liṅgadharmeṇa pārthivaiḥ loke bhūtāni sarvāṇi vicaranti na saṃśayaḥ
english: All beings, who must be cherished like sons by kings through the dharma proper to their station, move about in the world unharmed — of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit: sarvadharmaparaṃ kṣatraṃ lokajyeṣṭhaṃ sanātanam śaśvad akṣaraparyantam akṣaraṃ sarvatomukham
english: The kṣatriya order, devoted to all duties, foremost in the world and eternal, has the imperishable as its everlasting bound — itself imperishable and facing every direction.

sanskrit: indra uvāca evaṃvīryaḥ sarvadharmopapannaḥ; kṣātraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadharmeṣu dharmaḥ pālyo yuṣmābhir lokasiṃhair udārair; viparyaye syād abhāvaḥ prajānām
english: Indra said: Of such valour, endowed with all virtues, the kṣatriya dharma is the highest among all duties. It must be upheld by you, O noble lions among men; for in its reversal would come the ruin of the people.

sanskrit: bhuvaḥ saṃskāraṃ rājasaṃskārayogam; abhaikṣacaryāṃ pālanaṃ ca prajānām vidyād rājā sarvabhūtānukampāṃ; dehatyāgaṃ cāhave dharmam agryam
english: Let the king know as his foremost dharma the cultivation of the land, the rites of consecration befitting a king, the renunciation of begging, the protection of the people, compassion for all beings, and the surrender of his body in battle.

sanskrit: tyāgaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ munayo vai vadanti; sarvaśreṣṭho yaḥ śarīraṃ tyajeta nityaṃ tyaktaṃ rājadharmeṣu sarvaṃ; pratyakṣaṃ te bhūmipālāḥ sadaite
english: The sages declare renunciation the highest; best of all is he who would lay down his body. In the duties of kingship all is forever given up — these protectors of the earth are ever a witness before your eyes.

sanskrit: bahuśrutyā guruśuśrūṣayā vā; parasya vā saṃhananād vadanti nityaṃ dharmaṃ kṣatriyo brahmacārī; cared eko hy āśramaṃ dharmakāmaḥ
english: By wide learning, by service to the teacher, or by the slaying of an enemy, men declare it dharma. Let the kṣatriya, a celibate ever devoted to duty, longing for dharma, walk alone through the stages of life.

sanskrit: sāmānyārthe vyavahāre pravṛtte; priyāpriye varjayann eva yatnāt cāturvarṇyasthāpanāt pālanāc ca; tais tair yogair niyamair aurasaiś ca
english: When affairs touching the common good are afoot, carefully shunning both favour and disfavour, by establishing and protecting the four varṇas, and by those several disciplines, observances, and inborn means—

sanskrit: sarvodyogair āśramaṃ dharmam āhuḥ; kṣātraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ sarvadharmopapannam svaṃ svaṃ dharmaṃ ye na caranti varṇās; tāṃs tān dharmān ayathāvad vadanti
english: —by all such exertions they declare the dharma of the stages of life to be the kṣatriya dharma, the foremost, endowed with every virtue. Those varṇas who do not practise each their own duty, those very duties are pronounced ill-performed.

sanskrit: nirmaryāde nityam arthe vinaṣṭān; āhus tān vai paśubhūtān manuṣyān yathā nītiṃ gamayaty arthalobhāc; chreyāṃs tasmād āśramaḥ kṣatradharmaḥ
english: Men who are forever lost in lawless gain they call mere beasts in human form. Inasmuch as it leads to right conduct, away from greed for gain, the order of the kṣatriya dharma is therefore the better.

sanskrit: traividyānāṃ yā gatir brāhmaṇānāṃ; yaś caivokto 'thāśramo brāhmaṇānām etat karma brāhmaṇasyāhur agryam; anyat kurvañ śūdravac chastravadhyaḥ
english: That course belonging to the brāhmaṇas versed in the three Vedas, and that mode of life enjoined upon brāhmaṇas — this they call the brāhmaṇa's foremost work; doing otherwise, he is like a śūdra, fit to be slain by the sword.

sanskrit: cāturāśramyadharmāś ca vedadharmāś ca pārthiva brāhmaṇenānugantavyā nānyo vidyāt kathaṃ cana
english: The duties of the four āśramas and the duties of the Veda, O king, are to be followed by the brāhmaṇa; no other should know them in any way.

sanskrit: anyathā vartamānasya na sā vṛttiḥ prakalpyate karmaṇā vyajyate dharmo yathaiva śvā tathaiva saḥ
english: For one who conducts himself otherwise, that mode of livelihood is not allowed; dharma is made manifest by deeds — as is a dog, so is he.

sanskrit: yo vikarmasthito vipro na sa sanmānam arhati karmasv anupayuñjānam aviśvāsyaṃ hi taṃ viduḥ
english: A brāhmaṇa established in forbidden acts does not deserve honour; useless in his proper works, men know him to be unworthy of trust.

sanskrit: ete dharmāḥ sarvavarṇāś ca vīrair; utkraṣṭavyāḥ kṣatriyair eṣa dharmaḥ tasmāj jyeṣṭhā rājadharmā na cānye; vīryajyeṣṭhā vīradharmā matā me
english: These duties and all the varṇas are to be upheld by heroes, by kṣatriyas — this is their dharma. Therefore the duties of kingship are foremost, and no others; the duties of heroes, with valour foremost, are in my judgement supreme.

sanskrit: māndhātovāca yavanāḥ kirātā gāndhārāś cīnāḥ śabarabarbarāḥ śakās tuṣārāḥ kahvāś ca pahlavāś cāndhramadrakāḥ
english: Māndhātā said: The Yavanas, Kirātas, Gāndhāras, Cīnas, Śabaras, Barbaras, Śakas, Tuṣāras, Kahvas, Pahlavas, Āndhras, and Madrakas;

sanskrit: oḍrāḥ pulindā ramaṭhāḥ kācā mlecchāś ca sarvaśaḥ brahmakṣatraprasūtāś ca vaiśyāḥ śūdrāś ca mānavāḥ
english: the Oḍras, Pulindas, Ramaṭhas, Kācas, and barbarians of every kind; and the men sprung from brāhmaṇa and kṣatriya stock, the vaiśyas, and the śūdras—

sanskrit: kathaṃ dharmaṃ careyus te sarve viṣayavāsinaḥ madvidhaiś ca kathaṃ sthāpyāḥ sarve te dasyujīvinaḥ
english: how should all these who dwell within a realm practise dharma, and how are all those who live as outlaws to be set in order by men such as I?

sanskrit: etad icchāmy ahaṃ śrotuṃ bhagavaṃs tad bravīhi me tvaṃ bandhubhūto hy asmākaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ sureśvara
english: This I wish to hear, O Lord; tell it to me; for you have become a kinsman to us kṣatriyas, O lord of the gods.

sanskrit: indra uvāca mātāpitror hi kartavyā śuśrūṣā sarvadasyubhiḥ ācāryaguruśuśrūṣā tathaivāśramavāsinām
english: Indra said: Service to mother and father must be rendered by all outlaws, and likewise service to the teacher and the elders, and to those who dwell in the āśramas.

sanskrit: bhūmipālānāṃ ca śuśrūṣā kartavyā sarvadasyubhiḥ vedadharmakriyāś caiva teṣāṃ dharmo vidhīyate
english: Service to the protectors of the earth, too, must be rendered by all outlaws; and the rites enjoined by Vedic dharma are likewise ordained as their dharma.

sanskrit: pitṛyajñās tathā kūpāḥ prapāś ca śayanāni ca dānāni ca yathākālaṃ dvijeṣu dadyur eva te
english: Offerings to the ancestors, the digging of wells, watering-sheds, and resting-places, and gifts in due season to the twice-born — these too they should bestow.

sanskrit: ahiṃsā satyam akrodho vṛttidāyānupālanam bharaṇaṃ putradārāṇāṃ śaucam adroha eva ca
english: Non-injury, truth, freedom from anger, the giving and safeguarding of livelihood, the support of one's children and wife, purity, and the absence of malice;

sanskrit: dakṣiṇā sarvayajñānāṃ dātavyā bhūtim icchatā pākayajñā mahārhāś ca kartavyāḥ sarvadasyubhiḥ
english: the sacrificial fees of all sacrifices are to be given by one who desires prosperity; and the costly cooked-food offerings are to be performed by all outlaws.

sanskrit: etāny evaṃprakārāṇi vihitāni purānagha sarvalokasya karmāṇi kartavyānīha pārthiva
english: These works of such kinds, ordained of old, O sinless one, are the duties of all people, to be performed here, O king.

sanskrit: māndhātovāca dṛśyante mānavā loke sarvavarṇeṣu dasyavaḥ liṅgāntare vartamānā āśrameṣu caturṣv api
english: Māndhātā said: There are seen in the world, among all the varṇas, men who are outlaws — moving under another guise, present even within the four āśramas.

sanskrit: indra uvāca vinaṣṭāyāṃ daṇḍanītau rājadharme nirākṛte saṃpramuhyanti bhūtāni rājadaurātmyato nṛpa
english: Indra said: When the rod of justice is ruined and the duty of kingship cast aside, beings fall into utter confusion through the wickedness of the king, O lord of men.

sanskrit: asaṃkhyātā bhaviṣyanti bhikṣavo liṅginas tathā āśramāṇāṃ vikalpāś ca nivṛtte 'smin kṛte yuge
english: Countless mendicants and bearers of false marks will arise, and a confusion of the āśramas, once this Kṛta age has passed away.

sanskrit: aśṛṇvānāḥ purāṇānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ pravarā gatīḥ utpathaṃ pratipatsyante kāmamanyusamīritāḥ
english: Heedless of the supreme courses of the ancient duties, men will take to the wrong path, driven by desire and wrath.

sanskrit: yadā nivartyate pāpo daṇḍanītyā mahātmabhiḥ tadā dharmo na calate sadbhūtaḥ śāśvataḥ paraḥ
english: When the evildoer is restrained by the rod of justice in the hands of the great-souled, then dharma — true, eternal, and supreme — does not waver.

sanskrit: paralokaguruṃ caiva rājānaṃ yo 'vamanyate na tasya dattaṃ na hutaṃ na śrāddhaṃ phalati kva cit
english: Whoever slights the king, who is a guide even to the world beyond, for him neither gift, nor oblation, nor funeral rite ever bears any fruit.

sanskrit: mānuṣāṇām adhipatiṃ devabhūtaṃ sanātanam devāś ca bahu manyante dharmakāmaṃ nareśvaram
english: The lord of men, sovereign over mortals, become divine and everlasting, devoted to dharma — even the gods hold such a king in high honour.

sanskrit: prajāpatir hi bhagavān yaḥ sarvam asṛjaj jagat sa pravṛttinivṛttyarthaṃ dharmāṇāṃ kṣatram icchati
english: For the Lord Prajāpati, who created this whole world, desires the kṣatriya order for the sake of setting the duties in motion and bringing them to rest.

sanskrit: pravṛttasya hi dharmasya buddhyā yaḥ smarate gatim sa me mānyaś ca pūjyaś ca tatra kṣatraṃ pratiṣṭhitam
english: He who, with understanding, keeps in mind the course of dharma once set in motion — he is worthy of my honour and my worship; in him the kṣatriya order stands established.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca evam uktvā sa bhagavān marudgaṇavṛtaḥ prabhuḥ jagāma bhavanaṃ viṣṇur akṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam
english: Bhīṣma said: Having spoken thus, that Lord Viṣṇu, surrounded by the host of the Maruts, departed to his abode, the imperishable, the supreme station.

sanskrit: evaṃ pravartite dharme purā sucarite 'nagha kaḥ kṣatram avamanyeta cetanāvān bahuśrutaḥ
english: With dharma thus rightly set in motion of old, O sinless one, what man of sense and wide learning would slight the kṣatriya order?

sanskrit: anyāyena pravṛttāni nivṛttāni tathaiva ca antarā vilayaṃ yānti yathā pathi vicakṣuṣaḥ
english: Things begun unjustly, and likewise things so abandoned, pass to ruin midway, as a man without sight perishes upon the road.

sanskrit: ādau pravartite cakre tathaivādiparāyaṇe vartasva puruṣavyāghra saṃvijānāmi te 'nagha
english: With the wheel set turning at the beginning, and devoted to that first foundation, conduct yourself accordingly, O tiger among men; this I declare to you, O sinless one.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca śrutā me kathitāḥ pūrvaiś catvāro mānavāśramāḥ vyākhyānam eṣām ācakṣva pṛcchato me pitāmaha
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: I have heard the four āśramas of men as the ancients told them; expound their meaning to me who ask, O grandfather.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca viditāḥ sarva eveha dharmās tava yudhiṣṭhira yathā mama mahābāho viditāḥ sādhusaṃmatāḥ
english: Bhīṣma said: All these duties are known to you, Yudhiṣṭhira, even as they are known to me, O mighty-armed one — duties approved by the virtuous.

sanskrit: yat tu liṅgāntaragataṃ pṛcchase māṃ yudhiṣṭhira dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha tan nibodha narādhipa
english: But as for the dharma that passes under another guise, about which you ask me, Yudhiṣṭhira, O best of the upholders of dharma, hear that now, O lord of men.

sanskrit: sarvāṇy etāni kaunteya vidyante manujarṣabha sādhvācārapravṛttānāṃ cāturāśramyakarmaṇām
english: All these, O son of Kuntī, O bull among men, are found in those who, devoted to righteous conduct, perform the works of the four āśramas.

sanskrit: akāmadveṣayuktasya daṇḍanītyā yudhiṣṭhira samekṣiṇaś ca bhūteṣu bhaikṣāśramapadaṃ bhavet
english: For the king free from desire and hatred, who rules by the rod of justice and looks with even regard upon all beings, there comes the standing of the mendicant's āśrama, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: vetty ādānavisargaṃ yo nigrahānugrahau tathā yathoktavṛtter vīrasya kṣemāśramapadaṃ bhavet
english: For the hero who knows when to take and when to give, and likewise restraint and favour, and who lives by the rule laid down, there comes the standing of the āśrama of security.

sanskrit: jñātisaṃbandhimitrāṇi vyāpannāni yudhiṣṭhira samabhyuddharamāṇasya dīkṣāśramapadaṃ bhavet
english: For him who rescues his kinsmen, relations, and friends fallen into distress, O Yudhiṣṭhira, there comes the standing of the āśrama of consecration.

sanskrit: āhnikaṃ bhūtayajñāṃś ca pitṛyajñāṃś ca mānuṣān kurvataḥ pārtha vipulān vanyāśramapadaṃ bhavet
english: For him who performs his daily observances, and the sacrifices to beings, to the ancestors, and to men, in ample measure, O Pārtha, there comes the standing of the forest-dweller's āśrama.

sanskrit: pālanāt sarvabhūtānāṃ svarāṣṭraparipālanāt dīkṣā bahuvidhā rājño vanyāśramapadaṃ bhavet
english: By the protection of all beings and the safeguarding of his own realm, the king undertakes consecrations of many kinds; thus there comes to him the standing of the forest-dweller's āśrama.

sanskrit: vedādhyayananityatvaṃ kṣamāthācāryapūjanam tathopādhyāyaśuśrūṣā brahmāśramapadaṃ bhavet
english: Constancy in the study of the Veda, patience, the honouring of the teacher, and likewise service to the preceptor — these bring the standing of the brāhmaṇa's āśrama.

sanskrit: ajihmam aśaṭhaṃ mārgaṃ sevamānasya bhārata sarvadā sarvabhūteṣu brahmāśramapadaṃ bhavet
english: For him who ever treads a straight and guileless path toward all beings, O Bhārata, there comes the standing of the brāhmaṇa's āśrama.

sanskrit: vānaprastheṣu vipreṣu traividyeṣu ca bhārata prayacchato 'rthān vipulān vanyāśramapadaṃ bhavet
english: For him who bestows ample wealth upon forest-hermits, upon brāhmaṇas, and upon those versed in the three Vedas, O Bhārata, there comes the standing of the forest-dweller's āśrama.

sanskrit: sarvabhūteṣv anukrośaṃ kurvatas tasya bhārata ānṛśaṃsyapravṛttasya sarvāvasthaṃ padaṃ bhavet
english: For him who shows compassion toward all beings, O Bhārata, and is devoted to gentleness, there comes a standing that embraces every state.

sanskrit: bālavṛddheṣu kauravya sarvāvasthaṃ yudhiṣṭhira anukrośaṃ vidadhataḥ sarvāvasthaṃ padaṃ bhavet
english: For him who shows compassion toward the young and the old in every condition, O Kaurava, O Yudhiṣṭhira, there comes a standing that embraces every state.

sanskrit: balātkṛteṣu bhūteṣu paritrāṇaṃ kurūdvaha śaraṇāgateṣu kauravya kurvan gārhasthyam āvaset
english: By rendering deliverance to beings overpowered by force, O foremost of the Kurus, and to those who come seeking refuge, O Kaurava, a man may dwell in the householder's life.

sanskrit: carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ rakṣām api ca sarvaśaḥ yathārhapūjāṃ ca sadā kurvan gārhasthyam āvaset
english: By giving protection in every way to beings moving and unmoving, and by ever offering honour as is due, a man may dwell in the householder's life.

sanskrit: jyeṣṭhānujyeṣṭhapatnīnāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ putranaptṛṇām nigrahānugrahau pārtha gārhasthyam iti tat tapaḥ
english: Restraint and favour toward elder and younger wives, toward brothers, sons, and grandsons, O Pārtha — that is the householder's life, and that is its austerity.

sanskrit: sādhūnām arcanīyānāṃ prajāsu viditātmanām pālanaṃ puruṣavyāghra gṛhāśramapadaṃ bhavet
english: The protection of the worthy, deserving of honour, who are known among the people as masters of themselves, O tiger among men, brings the standing of the householder's āśrama.

sanskrit: āśramasthāni sarvāṇi yas tu veśmani bhārata ādadīteha bhojyena tad gārhasthyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira
english: He who in his own house, O Bhārata, takes up the duties belonging to all the āśramas by the giving of food — that is the householder's life, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: yaḥ sthitaḥ puruṣo dharme dhātrā sṛṣṭe yathārthavat āśramāṇāṃ sa sarveṣāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoty anuttamam
english: The man who stands firm in the dharma created by the Ordainer, fittingly and truly, attains the unsurpassed fruit of all the āśramas.

sanskrit: yasmin na naśyanti guṇāḥ kaunteya puruṣe sadā āśramasthaṃ tam apy āhur naraśreṣṭhaṃ yudhiṣṭhira
english: In whatever man his virtues never perish, O son of Kuntī, him too they call one established in an āśrama, that best of men, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: sthānamānaṃ vayomānaṃ kulamānaṃ tathaiva ca kurvan vasati sarveṣu hy āśrameṣu yudhiṣṭhira
english: Granting honour according to station, according to age, and likewise according to lineage, a man dwells in truth within all the āśramas, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: deśadharmāṃś ca kaunteya kuladharmāṃs tathaiva ca pālayan puruṣavyāghra rājā sarvāśramī bhavet
english: By upholding the customs of the land, O son of Kuntī, and likewise the customs of the lineage, O tiger among men, a king becomes a dweller in all the āśramas.

sanskrit: kāle vibhūtiṃ bhūtānām upahārāṃs tathaiva ca arhayan puruṣavyāghra sādhūnām āśrame vaset
english: By honouring in due season the prosperity of beings and likewise their offerings, O tiger among men, one may dwell in the āśrama of the virtuous.

sanskrit: daśadharmagataś cāpi yo dharmaṃ pratyavekṣate sarvalokasya kaunteya rājā bhavati so ''śramī
english: And he who, holding to the tenfold dharma, watches over the dharma of all the world, O son of Kuntī — that king becomes a dweller in an āśrama.

sanskrit: ye dharmakuśalā loke dharmaṃ kurvanti sādhavaḥ pālitā yasya viṣaye pādo 'ṃśas tasya bhūpateḥ
english: Of the good and skilled in dharma who practise dharma in the world, protected within a king's domain, a fourth part of their merit becomes the share of that lord of the earth.

sanskrit: dharmārāmān dharmaparān ye na rakṣanti mānavān pārthivāḥ puruṣavyāghra teṣāṃ pāpaṃ haranti te
english: But those kings who fail to protect men who delight in dharma and are devoted to dharma, O tiger among men — they take upon themselves the sin of such men.
